items.title: Rio Bonito (RJ) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #06
items.en_title: Rio Bonito (RJ) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #06
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Rio Bonito (RJ) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 4,933,160.88; proposals close Nov 19, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
